value.summary: The diff replaces a large inline struct (an EpisodeState::opened call with a nested Conversation) with two flat fields (watermark and round_start) plus a comment.  Nothing about this change introduces a security problem: no untrusted input path, no authentication/authorisation change, no new network or subprocess calls, no deserialization of untrusted data, no path traversal, no secrets moving into code or logs, no dependency change, and no CI-permission widening.  The new fields appear to be the direct decomposition of the former EpisodeState::opened constructor, so the behaviour is preserved.  No rule from AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md is violated.  The change looks sound.
